baseline.composer_version: not reported by current shell; executable discovery pending
baseline.audit_delta: Starting commit is the audit commit plus authentication unification and the committed audit package. See remediation-log.md.

findings.decision: Make company context mandatory and fail closed across all entry points; enforce service ownership and a generated two-company matrix.
tests: Phase 1 focused PHP gate: 23/23 passed, 84 assertions
evidence: Absent enforced context yields zero company-scoped rows and rejects writes
Web, API, Filament, map, service, and switch positive/negative paths are covered
Company switching is visible, membership-checked, session-bound, and activity-logged
Core financial, stock, sync, PDF, file, location, report, widget, and Livewire entry points use active context
findings.residual_risk: Additional new entry points must use the same context/service-boundary pattern; the release re-audit will rescan all company-bearing models and routes.

findings.decision: Use server-owned signed import state and transactional revalidation; reject negative, stale, duplicated, unknown, or cross-company rows.
findings.residual_risk: Mutable browser preview can tamper with stock imports.

findings.decision: Permit invoice-line-linked returns only and resolve quantity, price, tax, batch, and company under locks.
findings.residual_risk: Returns can create unsupported stock and credit.

findings.decision: Create stable intent IDs before confirmation, await IndexedDB durability, bind payload/type/version, and coordinate one device/multiple tabs.
findings.residual_risk: Retries can create duplicate financial mutations.

findings.decision: Remove demo/bootstrap commands from production deploy; implement explicit demo mode and secure one-time production bootstrap with generated credentials.
tests: ProductionDeploymentSafetyTest: production deploy, seeder refusal, bootstrap, generated credentials, banner, watermark, and integration-disable cases
Phase 1 focused PHP gate: 23/23 passed, 84 assertions
commands: source credential/default scan across railway.toml, app, database, config, stress tests, resources, and routes
evidence: Production predeploy contains no seeder or bootstrap command
JAWLA_MODE defaults to production and DemoSeeder refuses any other mode
Demo credentials are generated per identity into private mode-0600 storage and are never printed
Production bootstrap requires an empty database, explicit confirmation, and a strong environment-supplied secret
Demo UI/documents are permanently marked and irreversible tax submission is disabled
findings.residual_risk: Operators must enforce separate database and object-store resources; the documented runbook makes this a release/deployment acceptance check.

findings.decision: Remove rep undo for committed actions and implement manager-controlled immutable compensating reversals with reason, linkage, idempotency, dependency checks, and audit.
findings.residual_risk: Reps can reverse committed historical financial actions.

findings.decision: Resolve server-side effective price and tax; allow only explicit effective-dated manager overrides with reason and audit.
findings.residual_risk: Rep-controlled prices can corrupt invoice value and tax.

findings.decision: Remove local financial discard and implement durable audited conflict resolution with recoverable states and manager decision.
findings.residual_risk: The only copy of unsynced money/stock intent can be destroyed.

findings.decision: Implement one invoice/payment/credit/refund state machine; reject terminal payments, amend by credit plus replacement, and reconcile lifecycle postings.
findings.residual_risk: Payment, cancellation, and amendment can drift receivables and cash.

findings.decision: Implement versioned stock-count sessions using the same locked mutation primitive and immutable delta movements; prove with parallel PostgreSQL tests.
findings.residual_risk: Reconciliation can overwrite concurrent stock movement.

findings.decision: Use exact decimal strings/BCMath, database checks and same-company defenses, immutable ledgers, and scheduled non-destructive reconciliation.
findings.residual_risk: Float arithmetic and mutable summaries can accumulate undetected drift.

findings.decision: Accurately label standard invoices and verified Phase 1-style QR only; gate and disable unverified Phase 2 and ETA production features/claims.
findings.residual_risk: Unverified compliance features or claims may be exposed.

findings.decision: Render popup data as text or strictly encoded context, audit raw HTML sinks, add browser payload tests, and harden CSP.
tests: Playwright rep/customer stored payload corpus: 2/2 passed
evidence: Leaflet popup content is constructed with textContent/createTextNode DOM APIs
Element, event-handler, SVG, and URL-oriented stored payloads remain inert in both privileged maps
Production Vite build passes and the response CSP remains enforced
findings.residual_risk: Nonce rollout, remote asset removal, and removal of legacy CSP unsafe directives remain explicitly tracked under PR-022.

findings.decision: Migrate to five canonical roles; require admin MFA, dangerous-action step-up, session inventory/revocation, POST logout, identity-aware throttling, and correct proxy trust.
tests: RoleSeederTest proves all five canonical roles and read-only system_viewer
ProductGatesTest and AdminAccessTest prove removal of legacy global bypass behavior
Phase 1 focused PHP gate: 23/23 passed, 84 assertions
commands: php artisan test --compact tests/Feature/Roles/RoleSeederTest.php tests/Feature/Gates/ProductGatesTest.php tests/Feature/AdminAccessTest.php
evidence: sales_rep, sales_manager, hr_admin, warehouse_keeper, and system_viewer are provisioned
Global super_admin/admin Gate::before bypass is removed
system_viewer has no mutation permission
Core rep and admin access accepts canonical roles
findings.residual_risk: PR-014 remains a release blocker until Phase 5 removes legacy compatibility and completes MFA, step-up, session inventory/revocation, logout, throttling, and proxy-trust controls.

findings.decision: Require private storage/authorized delivery, safe image re-encoding and EXIF removal, visible active-shift GPS, configurable retention, bilingual notice, and audited access/export/delete.
findings.residual_risk: Files and precise employee location lack enforced privacy controls.

findings.decision: Implement approved core offline data, versioned protocol, payload hashes, dependencies/temp IDs, conflict states, compatibility, quota handling, registered devices, and safe upgrades.
findings.residual_risk: Offline lifecycle, device behavior, dependencies, and upgrades are undefined.

findings.decision: Operationalize independent encrypted database/private-object backups, age/failure alerts, restore tooling, and recorded scratch restore/reconciliation.
findings.residual_risk: Recovery, RPO, and RTO are unproven.

findings.decision: Use immutable artifacts, blocking CI/security, forward-compatible migrations/predeploy checks, versioned clients/protocol, staging parity, and rehearsed rollback without production demo seeds.
findings.residual_risk: Unsafe promotion and unproven rollback can corrupt or strand production.

findings.decision: Isolate PostgreSQL databases per run/process, establish clean sequential evidence, then safe parallelization and risk-driven release suites.
tests: Initial isolated sequential baseline: 467/468 passed; unified-login regression identified
Post-fix isolated sequential Unit and Feature: 476/476 passed, 1325 assertions
Unsafe DB integration check: suite refused DB_DATABASE=jawla before assertions
Bootstrap-provisioned DatabaseTransactions service test: 8/8 passed, 23 assertions
Exact combined CI command: 476/476 passed, 1325 assertions
evidence: Fresh migration completed successfully on the isolated named test database
Every TestCase now refuses non-testing, non-PostgreSQL, or non-jawla_test database configuration before application setup
PHPUnit bootstrap safely creates and migrates a missing sequential base database
Laravel per-worker databases are recreated and dropped by the blocking CI command
Tracked localhost cookie jar and opaque audit RAR were removed; CI blocks secret-bearing artifact filenames and runs Gitleaks
findings.residual_risk: Infrastructure isolation is proven. Risk-driven concurrency, tenant, browser/offline, restore, migration, accessibility, and security suites remain scheduled in later phases.

findings.decision: Exercise production-shaped writes and implement/test application, dependency, backup, security, and business-invariant monitoring with SEV runbooks.
findings.residual_risk: Capacity and incident detection/response are unproven.

findings.decision: Produce one current architecture/release contract, mark superseded documents, and align roles, deployment, offline, backup, compliance, support, and setup.
findings.residual_risk: Contradictory documentation misdirects operators and customers.

findings.decision: Bundle/pin assets, remove unsafe CSP directives through report-only rollout, and allowlist/scrub telemetry using business-data classification.
findings.residual_risk: Browser injection and telemetry privacy controls are incomplete.

findings.decision: Correct accessibility tokens and produce automated and manual WCAG 2.2 AA evidence for Arabic/English critical journeys.
findings.residual_risk: WCAG 2.2 AA production acceptance is unproven.

findings.decision: Add idempotent scheduled alerts for expiry, transfer ageing, sync conflicts, reconciliation, backup age, failed jobs, and stalled queues with delivery and overlap/retry tests.
findings.residual_risk: Operational exceptions can remain undiscovered.

findings.decision: Enforce same-company eligible batches and FEFO in the locked service across sale, return, reversal, transfer, credit, and quarantine.
findings.residual_risk: Batch-tracked inventory can lose lot/expiry traceability.

findings.decision: Implement approved transfer actors/states, partial receipt and immutable exceptions, enforcing conservation, company, ownership, endpoints, idempotency, and concurrency.
findings.residual_risk: Transfer authorization and exceptional states can violate conservation.

findings.decision: Separate legal sequence from public UUID and allocate atomically per company/type/year with no suffix, reuse, or silent gap closure.
findings.residual_risk: Official numbering can collide or violate sequential policy.

findings.decision: Implement linked credit notes and immutable customer credit/refund transactions, including approved cash and pending bank/card refund states.
findings.residual_risk: Paid returns and refunds have no valid settlement lifecycle.

findings.decision: Snapshot legal issuance values, store private artifact/hash/template and snapshot versions, currency and QR, and regenerate only from immutable snapshot.
findings.residual_risk: Historical invoices can change after master-data edits or cache loss.

findings.decision: Disable ETA production controls/claims behind an explicit experimental flag and prohibit unsigned/unvalidated remote submission.
findings.residual_risk: Unsigned scaffold may be exposed as production integration.

findings.decision: Prohibit hard deletion/cascade loss of financial, stock, audit, sequence, sync, credit, refund, and reconciliation history; archive masters and use compensation.
findings.residual_risk: Deletion paths can destroy ledger evidence.
